sources.excerpt: Bulls On by BSQ Effects | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE BSQ Effects Bulls On LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE COMPRESSOR Description We spend a lot of time designing the best guitar pedals, and forget about your trusty 4-string companion... or 5... or who knows how many. That's why we decided to create the Bulls On BO2. Inspired by an exhaustive analysis of a large number of musical genres and their performers, we squeezed our inventiveness to design a pedal that would be functional for any bass player and any style. For this reason, and with the extraordinary dynamics of the bass in mind, we developed the heart of the Bulls On to respond to both the most subtle playing and the most furious slap, from sweet, rounded sound to sharp, aggressive distortion. We know how important the unique and unrepeatable personal touch is... The DNA of your playing... That's why we believe the blend control, which allows you to balance the direct signal with the processed signal, is indispensable. Overdrive? Distortion? Fuzz? The most fantastic thing about this pedal is that thanks to the variety of settings you can call it whatever you want! The combination of the ultra-versatile saturation and the full-featured professional compressor makes the Bulls On BO2 the ideal companion for any bass player.
